single_day_rule: This board is 2026-10-15 only. Priced rows for another day are not shown here and neither are parlays that would cross days — a card dated one day and half-filled with the next is two facts under one label. Minimum 5, maximum 25; a day with no games is an empty board, and that is correct.
coverage: 150 priced football rows for 2026-10-15 across 3 board games; 25 shown.
calibration_warning: This card changed how it rates: it now reads this season first and pulls thin records toward the average; before the change, when it said 70-80%, those plays hit 33.3% (12 graded). That earlier record is kept apart and is not counted in the figures below. under-60 hit 65.9% against a claimed 52% (+13.9 pts, n=41). The under-60 band is currently the closest to its own claim. 60-70 has too few graded plays to read. 41 graded College Football plays behind these figures, under the 100 this project needs before it will call a percentage a rate — so read them as history rather than a measured rate, and every one of them will move.
board_rule: Sorted by confidence, highest first — the same order the MLB board uses: the props model's chance where it priced the prop, the player's own record at that exact line otherwise. Rows with neither sit below every row that has one.
college_note: College records are counted over the games a player appears in. College box scores list him only when he did something, so a game he played quietly can be missing — which nudges an over slightly high. That gap was measured against the NFL, where the true figure is known: a median of 0.2 percentage points and 3.8 at the 90th percentile. Short reception lines, where the gap is biggest, carry no record at all.
